title: Drop JavaScript and Discord leftovers from .gitignore
raw:
Drop JavaScript and Discord leftovers from .gitignore

node_modules/, operator.local.*, *.sqlite* belonged to the JS bot;
config.json and .local-lavalink/ belong to the Discord bot. The Telegram
bot never creates them.
